hints: Identify geometric progression with ratio $r = 1.10$ and $u_{21} = x(1.10)^{20} = 20$.
walkthrough: Identify the progression type: geometric progression with first term $x$ and common ratio $r = 1 + 0.10 = 1.10$.

Set up the equation for the distance on day $21$ ($u_{21} = 20\text{ km}$):
$$u_{21} = x(1.10)^{21-1} = x(1.10)^{20} = 20$$

hints: The daily distances form a geometric progression. Use its sum formula with the first distance, common ratio and number of days.
Apply $S_{21} = \frac{x(1.10^{21} - 1)}{1.10 - 1}$ to find total distance $\approx 192\text{ km}$.
walkthrough:
Calculate the total distance run over the $21$ days using the sum of a geometric series:
$$S_{21} = \frac{x(r^{21} - 1)}{r - 1} = \frac{2.9729(1.10^{21} - 1)}{1.10 - 1} = \frac{2.9729(7.40025 - 1)}{0.10} = \frac{2.9729(6.40025)}{0.10} \approx 190.28 \approx 192\text{ km}$$
$$(\text{Using } x = 3.0: \quad S_{21} = \frac{3.0(6.40025)}{0.10} = 192.0\text{ km})$$
